title: Sony × TSMC — $6.3B Image Sensor Joint Venture for Physical AI
summary: Sony Group and Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company finalized plans for a joint venture with a capital commitment of approximately 1 trillion yen ($6.32 billion) to build an advanced image sensor fabrication facility in Kumamoto Prefecture, Japan, targeting next-generation chips for autonomous vehicles, industrial robotics, and physical AI applications, with commercial production starting as early as 2029.

title: Great British Energy × Naked Energy — UK Solar-Thermal Manufacturing Scale-Up
summary: Crawley-based renewable-heat technology company Naked Energy secured a €10.35 million investment led by publicly-owned Great British Energy, with participation from Barclays Climate Ventures, to build a new UK manufacturing facility for its Virtu solar-thermal collectors, creating up to 140 jobs and scaling domestic production to decarbonize industrial process heat.

title: ABN AMRO × Mistral AI — Sovereign AI Banking Partnership
summary: Dutch bank ABN AMRO agreed a strategic partnership with Mistral, Europe's fastest-growing Frontier AI lab, to jointly explore and build AI tools for the bank — marking Mistral's first tie-up with a major Netherlands-based lender and giving ABN AMRO access to frontier AI built and overseen within Europe.

title: UniCredit × Accenture × IBM — European Banking Technology Restructuring
summary: Accenture agreed to acquire IBM's majority stake in V-TServices, the technology joint venture managing a significant portion of UniCredit's IT infrastructure across its thirteen European markets, giving the pan-European banking group tighter control over its technology evolution, cloud, data, and AI implementation, while IBM continues to supply IBM Z platforms, software, and consulting.

title: SEALSQ × GlobalFoundries — Post-Quantum Cryptography & Quantum Computing MoU
summary: SEALSQ, a Geneva-based leader in post-quantum semiconductor and cybersecurity technology, signed a strategic MoU with GlobalFoundries to co-develop secure semiconductor platforms, Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC), and emerging semiconductor-based quantum computing technologies, leveraging GF's process technology and SEALSQ's PQC-ready silicon expertise.

title: Zscaler × Schwarz Digits — Sovereign Cloud Cybersecurity
summary: Zscaler, the cybersecurity platform for the AI era, and Schwarz Digits, the IT and digital division of Schwarz Group, announced a strategic partnership allowing European customers to use Zscaler's cybersecurity platform hosted in German data centers via Schwarz Digits' sovereign cloud.

title: Ford × Geely — Valencia Manufacturing JV: 500,000-Unit EV and Multi-Energy Production from 2027
companies: Ford Motor Company, Geely Automobile Holdings
summary: Ford Motor Company (66%) and Geely Automobile Holdings (34%) agreed to form a manufacturing joint venture at Ford’s Valencia Almussafes plant in Spain. The JV targets 500,000 units per year from 2027, producing a Ford multi-energy crossover, a European Ford Bronco and two all-electric Geely SUVs including the Geely EX5. Ford contributes plant capacity and brand engineering; Geely provides modular EV architecture, electric powertrain technology and capital. ‘Made in Europe’ status enables Geely models to bypass EU import tariffs on Chinese-made EVs. Ford Kuga PHEV production continues during the retooling transition.

title: METLEN (M Technologies) × HOUTRIS — Military Land Vehicle Manufacturing JV in Cyprus
companies: METLEN Energy & Resources, M Technologies, HOUTRIS
summary: METLEN Energy & Resources, via its defence unit M Technologies, entered into an exclusive partnership with Cypriot manufacturer HOUTRIS to create a new joint company in Cyprus dedicated to the production and integration of military land vehicles and defence systems. The alliance operates under the European Strategic Assistance and Financing Environment (SAFE) programme, positioning Cyprus as a manufacturing hub for EU-funded European defence procurement.

title: Microsoft × Mistral AI — Multibillion-Dollar European Sovereign AI Expansion
summary: Microsoft committed billions to fund Mistral AI's data centre growth across Europe, integrating Mistral's frontier models into Microsoft Foundry, Copilot Studio and Azure. Azure customers can develop software using Mistral's France-based data centres, powered by thousands of NVIDIA Vera Rubin GPUs. Mistral Medium 3.5 and OCR 4 are now live on Microsoft Foundry and Copilot Studio. The partnership enables deployment across public cloud, hybrid and fully disconnected sovereign environments, targeting 1 GW of Mistral compute capacity by 2030. Cited: Brad Smith (Vice Chair & President, Microsoft) and Arthur Mensch (CEO, Mistral AI).

title: Humanoid × Schaeffler — Europe’s First Humanoid Robotics Unicorn: $152M Series A at $1.35B Valuation
companies: Humanoid, Schaeffler, Bosch, SAP, NVIDIA, Siemens, Prime Movers Lab
summary: UK-based Humanoid announced a $152 million Series A at a $1.35 billion post-money valuation, becoming Europe's first pure-play humanoid robotics unicorn. The round was led by Prime Movers Lab with participation from Schaeffler, Bosch and Fubon Financial. Humanoid signed the industry's largest publicly announced commercial agreement with Schaeffler for large-scale deployment of thousands of humanoid robots in manufacturing environments. Robert Bosch Robotics GmbH also entered a manufacturing partnership with Humanoid. Additional partnerships with SAP, NVIDIA and Siemens. Beta robots roll out to customers in Q4 2026 across logistics, manufacturing and retail.

title: Leonardo × Baykar — LBA Systems JV: European Manufacturing of Advanced Drone Platforms
summary: Announced at the Farnborough International Airshow, LBA Systems — a 50/50 joint venture between Italy’s Leonardo S.p.A. and Turkey’s Baykar — achieved full operational readiness following regulatory clearance. Headquartered in Italy, LBA Systems integrates Leonardo’s avionics, radar, electro-optical payloads and electronic warfare suites into Baykar’s uncrewed platforms including the KALKAN ISR drone, Bayraktar TB2, AKINCI and KIZILELMA. Manufacturing, integration and servicing for Western markets will be executed at dedicated facilities in Italy, localising advanced autonomous systems production within the EU defence industrial base.

title: Saft (TotalEnergies) × Naval Group — Sovereign Lithium-Ion Batteries for Barracuda and Scorpene Submarines
summary: Saft, a TotalEnergies subsidiary, secured a major strategic contract from Naval Group to supply proprietary lithium-ion battery systems for the Barracuda and Scorpene submarine classes. Transitioning from legacy lead-acid chemistry, Saft’s defence-grade Li-ion technology delivers higher energy density, extending underwater mission endurance and tactical stealth. Battery cell electrochemistry design and manufacturing are fully localised in France, aligning with French and European defence sovereignty mandates. Both companies are French, making this a fully sovereign EU defence energy partnership.

title: AMD × Microsoft — Helios Rack-Scale AI System Deployed at Scale Across Azure
summary: AMD announced an expanded strategic partnership with Microsoft spanning GPUs, CPUs, networking and software on Azure. Microsoft will ramp AMD Helios at scale to power frontier model AI inference and Azure AI services. Helios integrates AMD Instinct MI455X GPUs, AMD EPYC Venice CPUs, Pensando networking and ROCm software. Azure will also add two new VM series powered by 6th Gen EPYC Venice processors. AMD shares rose nearly 5% on the announcement. Microsoft joins Meta, OpenAI and Oracle as major Helios customers. AMD plans to book tens of billions in data centre AI revenue from Helios starting 2027. Cited: Scott Guthrie (EVP Cloud + AI, Microsoft).

title: NOBA Bank × Tieto Banktech — Verification of Payee Payment Security Across Nordic Operations
companies: NOBA Bank Group, Tieto Banktech, Bank Norwegian, Nordax Bank
summary: NOBA Bank Group, parent of Bank Norwegian and Nordax Bank, partnered with Tieto Banktech to deploy Verification of Payee (VoP) capabilities across its Nordic operations. The rollout covers both the European Payments Council (EPC) VoP and the Nordic VoP (NVOP) scheme, enabling NOBA to handle Euro transactions and Nordic payments. Finland is the initial launch market, with infrastructure built to extend across all NOBA territories. The deployment adds a further layer of fraud protection to NOBA's existing payments and fraud framework.

title: EWE AG × Verbund — EC-Approved Green Hydrogen JV: 320 MW Electrolyser Linked to Germany’s Hydrogen Grid
companies: EWE AG, EWE Hydrogen GmbH, Verbund AG, Verbund Green Hydrogen GmbH
summary: The European Commission formally approved the 50/50 joint venture between Germany’s EWE AG and Austria’s Verbund AG. The JV centres on EWE’s €800 million Clean Hydrogen Coastline initiative in Emden — a 320 MW electrolyser targeting 27,000 tonnes of green hydrogen annually by 2027, linked directly into Germany’s 9,000 km Wasserstoff-Kernnetz. Verbund contributes hydropower-driven electrolysers including a 60 MW facility in Linz, alongside North Africa import routes under the H2 Notos project in Tunisia.

title: ÆTHER Consortium — European AI Gigafactory in Strasbourg: SiPearl, 2CRSi, Dassault Systèmes, Nhood, SOCOMEC
companies: SiPearl, 2CRSi, Dassault Systèmes, Nhood, SOCOMEC, Projex, AETHER Infrastructures
summary: The European consortium ÆTHER unveiled its founding members and applied for the European Commission’s AI Gigafactory call for proposals under the EU digital and industrial sovereignty strategy. Members include hardware firms SiPearl and 2CRSi, software group Dassault Systèmes, real estate operator Nhood, energy systems provider SOCOMEC and infrastructure developer Projex. ÆTHER is in advanced negotiations to acquire two industrial sites in the Strasbourg region targeting 400 MW total electrical capacity, with the first campus (FR-SXB1) expected to begin operations in 2027.

title: Groupe BPCE × Nexity — Residential Real Estate Distribution Joint Venture in France
companies: Groupe BPCE, Nexity, iSelection, Perl, BPCE Solutions immobilières
summary: French banking group Groupe BPCE and real estate developer Nexity entered exclusive negotiations to form a joint venture combining Nexity’s distribution subsidiaries iSelection and Perl with BPCE Solutions immobilières. The joint venture serves property developers by marketing new and renovated homes to retail investors and first-time buyers through the Banque Populaire and Caisse d’Epargne networks. Targeted for operational launch no later than January 1, 2027, the JV creates one of France’s largest integrated real estate distribution platforms.

title: ielo × MIX (Milan Internet Exchange) — Direct France-Italy Fiber Peering Axis
summary: French fiber operator ielo partnered with Italy’s leading Internet Exchange Point MIX at the Via Caldera campus in Milan, establishing a direct France-Italy peering axis. Using active transport links across Lyon, Nice and Milan, the partnership enables European carriers to exchange internet traffic locally without routing through Northern European hubs, lowering latency and improving routing autonomy. The deal creates a sovereign south-western European transit corridor for internet traffic.

title: Altris × Draslovka — Europe’s First Industrial Sodium-Ion Cathode Supply Chain
summary: Swedish battery developer Altris and Czech specialty chemicals group Draslovka established Europe’s first industrial-scale sodium-ion cathode supply chain. Supported by a €19.3 million strategic in-kind investment, a production line at Draslovka’s Kolín facility in Czech Republic is being converted for Altris’ patented Prussian White Cathode Active Material (CAM). Production in Q3/Q4 2026 will yield up to 350 tonnes annually (~175 MWh of sodium-ion cell capacity), providing a fully European-controlled alternative to lithium-based chemistry for grid storage and urban mobility.

title: SoftBank × Schneider Electric — €75B AI Data Centre Infrastructure Hub in France
summary: SoftBank Group committed €75 billion to build 5 gigawatts of AI data centre capacity across France, naming Schneider Electric as a primary strategic infrastructure partner. The partnership focuses on the physical AI supply chain: Schneider Electric will provide power management systems, thermal cooling, and robotics manufacturing for the first-phase site in Dunkirk — creating a centralised hardware hub to support Northern European AI scaling. This marks a shift from software to physical infrastructure partnerships in the AI race.

title: Checkout.com × BLIK — Direct Scheme Integration Across Central & Eastern Europe
summary: Global digital payments processor Checkout.com became a direct scheme member and official partner of BLIK, Poland's dominant mobile payment network. The integration embeds BLIK's native app-to-checkout protocols and newly launched recurring payment functionality into Checkout.com's European network. International e-commerce marketplaces can now eliminate payment routing middlemen and reduce transaction friction across Central and Eastern Europe — a high-growth, underserved corridor for global merchants.

title: AirPlus × Kresus Technologies × Mastercard — B2B Tail Spend Automation Alliance
summary: Corporate payment specialist AirPlus International formed a tripartite alliance with European B2B fintech Kresus Technologies and Mastercard to target corporate tail spend — the unmanaged indirect purchasing that bleeds corporate cash flow. Kresus's intelligent cloud payment orchestration paired with AirPlus's corporate billing and Mastercard's global merchant network provides European enterprises with virtual card controls to automate everyday indirect company expenses.

title: Airbus × Mistral AI — European Sovereign Deep Tech AI Deployment
summary: Airbus signed a major corporate-level deployment partnership with French AI firm Mistral AI, embedding Mistral's full suite of generative AI models across commercial aviation, defence, space and helicopter systems. The data sovereignty strategy ensures classified military and aerospace operations run locally or via trusted European clouds rather than on US hyperscaler infrastructure. The partnership makes Airbus a landmark anchor customer for European sovereign AI and reinforces Mistral's position as the EU's leading frontier model provider.

title: Adyen × ROLLER — ROLLER Capital: Embedded Finance for Leisure & Entertainment Venues
summary: Global fintech platform Adyen partnered with ROLLER — a software platform used by thousands of leisure and entertainment venues — to launch ROLLER Capital using Adyen's embedded finance infrastructure. Thousands of European and UK entertainment venues can now access fast, automated business loans directly inside their native venue management software, bypassing traditional banks. The partnership allows Adyen to capture a highly lucrative vertical SaaS B2B market while ROLLER adds a high-margin financial product to its platform.

title: Anthropic × Amazon & Google & Broadcom — Series H Infrastructure Alliances (10GW)
summary: Tied to Anthropic's historic $65 billion Series H funding round (valuation: $965 billion), Anthropic signed monumental multi-party infrastructure agreements. Amazon deal: 5 GW of dedicated energy and server capacity to power Claude Opus 4.8 and cyber-defence models. Google and Broadcom deal: additional 5 GW of next-generation TPU capacity. Together the two agreements secure 10 GW of dedicated AI compute infrastructure — an unprecedented physical commitment underpinning Anthropic's frontier AI ambitions.

title: Snowflake × AWS — $6B Enterprise Agentic AI Strategic Collaboration
summary: Snowflake signed a 5-year, $6 billion multi-year strategic collaboration agreement with AWS — its largest infrastructure commitment ever — committing to AWS Graviton and Trainium compute to accelerate enterprise agentic AI adoption. Snowflake has surpassed $7 billion in lifetime AWS Marketplace sales. Alongside this, Snowflake announced a definitive agreement to acquire Natoma, an enterprise Model Context Protocol (MCP) governance platform. Snowflake stock surged 36% on the announcement day.

title: Centrica × SAP SE — Enterprise AI for Green Energy Trading & Grid Forecasting
summary: UK energy giant Centrica (parent of British Gas) finalised a sweeping digital infrastructure partnership with SAP SE, integrating SAP's Joule AI companion into Centrica's primary corporate operations. In a volatile energy market, the two companies are building unified data models to optimise green energy logistics, automate supply chain compliance, and deploy agentic AI for grid-readiness forecasting across Centrica's European assets. The partnership gives Centrica one of the most sophisticated AI-native energy trading and operations stacks in Europe.

title: Snowflake × Natoma — MCP Governance Platform Acquisition for Enterprise AI Agents
summary: Alongside its $6B AWS strategic collaboration, Snowflake signed a definitive agreement to acquire Natoma — an enterprise Model Context Protocol (MCP) platform — to add an identity and governance layer for AI agents operating across enterprise workflows. The acquisition directly addresses the key barrier enterprises face in scaling agentic AI safely, extending governance to AI-driven actions beyond data management.

title: EY × Microsoft — $1B+ Global Enterprise AI Initiative
summary: EY and Microsoft jointly committed over $1 billion across five years to help large enterprises move AI from pilot to production. The initiative pairs Microsoft Forward Deployed Engineers with EY industry professionals to accelerate AI adoption across finance, tax, HR and supply chain. EY is acting as Client Zero, already scaling Microsoft 365 Copilot across its 400,000+ global staff. Announced in London on May 21, 2026. Key executives cited: Judson Althoff (CEO of Microsoft's commercial business) and Errol Gardner (EY Global Vice Chair of Consulting).

title: NextEra Energy × Caliber Resource Partners — $1.3B Acquisition + Shale JV with Quantum Capital
companies: NextEra Energy, Caliber Resource Partners, Quantum Capital Group
summary: NextEra Energy agreed to acquire Caliber Resource Partners for $1.3 billion and simultaneously formed a shale joint venture with Caliber's PE backer Quantum Capital Group to manage NextEra's US shale assets. The move signals NextEra expanding beyond renewables into flexible gas and shale to meet the surging power demands of AI hyperscale data centres. NextEra is targeting 15 GW of power for data centre hubs by 2035.

title: Anthropic × PwC — Expanded Strategic Alliance: Claude Across 364,000 Professionals
summary: PwC and Anthropic expanded their strategic alliance, deploying Claude Code and Cowork across PwC's global workforce of 364,000+ professionals across 136 countries. 30,000 US staff will be trained and certified on Claude. The expansion established a joint Centre of Excellence and sharpened focus on three areas: agentic technology build, AI-native dealmaking, and enterprise function redesign. Production deployments already live — insurance underwriting compressed from 10 weeks to 10 days at one client. Cited: Dario Amodei (CEO, Anthropic) and Paul Griggs (Senior Partner & CEO, PwC US).

title: Blackstone × Skroutz — €635M Acquisition of Greece’s Leading Online Marketplace
summary: Blackstone agreed to acquire a majority stake in Skroutz — Greece's leading online marketplace — from CVC Capital Partners Fund VII, valuing it at €635M including debt (CVC doubles its investment). Skroutz is a vertically integrated platform serving ~2.5M active users with 12M+ products from ~9,000 merchants, combining marketplace, proprietary last-mile logistics, fulfilment, fintech and retail media. George Chatzigeorgiou remains CEO; founders retain a stake.

title: OpenAI — The Development Company: $4B+ AI Professional Services Venture
summary: OpenAI raised over $4 billion for a new professional services entity — The Development Company — from a 19-firm syndicate led by TPG. The vehicle competes directly with McKinsey, Bain and Capgemini as a consulting distribution channel for deploying AI at enterprise scale. Alongside this, OpenAI acquired Tomoro for approximately 150 Forward Deployed Engineers. The move mirrors Anthropic's contemporaneous PwC alliance but with a different structure: OpenAI is building its own services bench rather than embedding within an existing firm.

title: Stellantis × Leapmotor — European EV Manufacturing at Zaragoza & Madrid: Chinese Tech, Spanish Production
summary: Stellantis and Leapmotor expanded their partnership from distribution JV to deep industrial manufacturing collaboration. Leapmotor B10 EV production moves to Zaragoza (Spain) from 2026; a new Opel electric C-SUV using Leapmotor architecture and components follows from 2028. Villaverde (Madrid) plant ownership under discussion for transfer to LPMI Spanish subsidiary for Leapmotor EU/MEA export production — bypassing EU tariffs on Chinese-made EVs.

title: Apple × Intel — Preliminary US Chip Manufacturing Agreement
summary: Apple and Intel reached a preliminary agreement for Intel to manufacture some chips powering Apple devices — potentially M-series chips for Mac and iPad. Talks were ongoing for over a year and facilitated by the US government, which holds a ~10% stake in Intel. The deal diversifies Apple's supply chain away from TSMC and supports US domestic chip manufacturing ambitions under the Trump administration's industrial policy.

title: KPMG × ServiceNow — $40M AI Agent Enterprise Transformation Partnership
summary: KPMG and ServiceNow announced a multi-year commitment with $40 million in services over three years to accelerate AI-powered enterprise transformation. KPMG UK is one of the first and largest European deployers of ServiceNow AI Agents in a live environment, managing Global Business Services workflows across HR, procurement and finance. The partnership is anchored by KPMG Ignition centres for co-creation of agentic operating models.

title: IBM × Aramco — Industrial AI Collaboration for Saudi Arabia's Energy Sector
summary: Announced at IBM Think Boston in the presence of Arvind Krishna (Chairman & CEO, IBM) and Sami Al Ajmi (SVP Digital & IT, Aramco), the collaboration aims to advance agentic AI, automation, and materials science across Saudi Arabia's industrial sector. Combines IBM's watsonx platform with Aramco's 90 years of energy operations data. Aramco's existing AI programmes contributed an estimated $2.6B in value in 2025.

title: SAP × Prior Labs — €1B Acquisition to Build EU Frontier AI Lab for Structured Data
summary: SAP agreed to acquire Freiburg-based Prior Labs — an 18-month-old German AI startup and pioneer of Tabular Foundation Models (TFMs) built for structured enterprise data. SAP committed to investing more than €1 billion over four years to scale it into a globally leading frontier AI lab, operating independently. Prior Labs' TabPFN model has been downloaded 3M+ times and set state-of-the-art on tabular benchmarks. One of Germany's largest-ever venture exits, with founders receiving over $500M in cash.

title: Pentagon × OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, Nvidia, AWS, SpaceX, Oracle & Reflection AI — AI on Classified Military Networks
companies: Pentagon, OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, Nvidia, AWS, SpaceX, Oracle, Reflection AI
summary: The US Department of Defense signed agreements with eight leading AI firms to deploy frontier AI models on its IL6 (Secret) and IL7 (Top Secret) classified military networks. Emil Michael (Pentagon CTO) confirmed that 1.3 million DoD personnel are already using GenAI.mil. The deal marks a decisive step in integrating commercial AI into mission-critical defence infrastructure, covering OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, Nvidia, AWS, SpaceX, Oracle and Reflection AI.

title: EPH × TotalEnergies — TTEP: Europe's 2nd Largest Flexible Power Generation JV (14 GW)
summary: EPH and TotalEnergies completed a 50/50 joint venture creating TTEP — the 2nd largest flexible power generation company in Europe. TTEP operates 14 GW of flexible gas, biomass and battery storage assets across five EU markets. EPH received approximately 95.4 million TotalEnergies shares (4.2% stake). The JV has a 5 GW project pipeline for battery energy storage and flexible gas generation, serving as the essential balancing force for Europe's decarbonising grid.

title: Verda — €100M for European Sovereign AI Cloud Infrastructure
summary: Helsinki-based Verda (formerly DataCrunch) raised €100 million to scale its sovereign European AI cloud infrastructure — positioning itself as a GDPR-compliant, EU-controlled alternative to US hyperscalers for AI compute. Targets governments, enterprises and research institutions requiring European-sovereign AI infrastructure. Part of a broader wave of EU capital going into sovereign AI compute.

title: ECB × ECPC, Nexo Standards & Berlin Group — Digital Euro Open Standards Partnership
companies: ECB, ECPC, Nexo Standards, Berlin Group
summary: The European Central Bank signed formal partnership agreements with ECPC, Nexo Standards and the Berlin Group — Europe’s three main payment standards bodies — to ensure the digital euro uses open, existing standards compatible with current payment infrastructure. Gives EU-licensed PSPs and merchants the regulatory certainty needed to invest in digital euro-ready infrastructure ahead of a potential 2029 issuance.

title: Lyft × Gett — Acquiring London’s Leading Black Cab App for ~$55M
summary: Lyft agreed to acquire Gett’s UK business for approximately $55 million, becoming the dominant app for London’s iconic black cabs. Gett connects riders to three-quarters of Greater London’s registered black cab drivers. Combined with Freenow, Lyft will nearly double rides in London and establish itself as the leading ground transport platform in the capital, with deep B2B relationships with the BBC, Transport for London and major London corporations.

title: Nvidia × Google Cloud — AI Hypercomputer for Agentic & Physical AI Factories
summary: Nvidia and Google Cloud deepened their decade-long partnership at Google Cloud Next 2026, unveiling the AI Hypercomputer expansion with new A5X bare-metal instances powered by Nvidia Vera Rubin NVL72. Delivers 10x lower inference cost per token and 10x higher token throughput per megawatt versus the prior generation. Scales to ~960,000 Vera Rubin GPUs across multisite clusters. Covers agentic AI, physical AI, robotics and digital twins.

title: Merck × Google Cloud — $1B Agentic AI Enterprise Transformation
summary: Merck and Google Cloud announced a landmark multi-year partnership valued at up to $1 billion to deploy Gemini Enterprise across all of Merck's operations — R&D, manufacturing, commercial and corporate functions. Google engineers are embedded directly with Merck teams. Already cut reimbursement dossier preparation time and cost by half in live regulatory submissions across multiple countries. Covers 75,000 employees globally.

title: Google Cloud $750M Partner AI Fund — Accenture, Deloitte, McKinsey & BCG
companies: Google Cloud, Accenture, Deloitte, McKinsey, BCG
summary: Google Cloud committed $750 million at Cloud Next 2026 to accelerate agentic AI adoption across its 120,000-member partner ecosystem. Accenture, BCG, Deloitte and McKinsey get early Gemini model access. 70+ pre-built agents launched in the new Agent Marketplace. Forward-deployed engineers embedded with leading partners. 95% of the top 20 SaaS companies already using Gemini models.

title: BANCOMAT × EPI × SIBS-MB WAY — Europe’s First Cross-Border QR Payment Interoperability PoC
summary: BANCOMAT, EPI (Wero) and SIBS-MB WAY successfully completed the first joint technical proof-of-concept for pan-European payment interoperability — users of each national mobile payment app paid seamlessly at the other networks' merchants across borders via QR code P2M payments. Supported by La Banque Postale, Intesa Sanpaolo and 28 MB WAY banks. Roadmap: P2P cross-border payments in 2026, full e-commerce and NFC POS by 2027.

title: Salesupply × BrandOn Group — End-to-End Solution for Italian Brands Going International
summary: Dutch ecommerce fulfilment provider Salesupply and Italian marketplace growth platform BrandOn Group partnered to give Italian brands a single integrated solution for international expansion — combining BrandOn's marketplace and social commerce expertise with Salesupply's cross-border fulfilment, customer service and returns management across major EU markets. Used by 500+ brands worldwide.

title: Stellantis × Microsoft — 5-Year AI & Cloud Partnership Across 100+ Global Initiatives
summary: Stellantis and Microsoft signed a five-year strategic deal to co-develop AI, cybersecurity and engineering capabilities across the automaker’s global operations. Covers 100+ AI initiatives across customer care, product development and manufacturing, an AI-driven global cyberdefense centre, and a target 60% reduction in datacenter footprint by 2029 via Azure.

title: Rheinmetall × Bundeswehr — €298M Attack Drone Contract for the German Military
summary: Germany’s parliament awarded Rheinmetall a contract to supply attack drones to the Bundeswehr worth approximately €298 million if quality standards are met. The contract follows €536M in drone contracts awarded to Helsing and Stark Defence in February. The Bundeswehr is pursuing a parallel development approach across all three suppliers, drawing directly on lessons from Ukraine’s battlefield experience.

title: Capacity × Widem Logistics — US Fulfillment Player Enters EU via Strategic Partnership
summary: US-based Capacity LLC expanded into the EU through a strategic partnership with Widem Logistics, enabling in-region e-commerce fulfillment across multiple EU countries. Combines Capacity’s high-growth brand fulfillment expertise with Widem’s pan-European warehousing, international transport and customs clearance infrastructure.

title: Thoma Bravo × Google Cloud — AI Transformation for $300B+ Enterprise Software Portfolio
summary: The world’s largest software-focused PE firm and Google Cloud launched a strategic partnership giving Thoma Bravo’s entire portfolio — worth $300B+ — streamlined access to Gemini models, Gemini Enterprise for agentic AI, Google forward-deployed engineers and Google Cloud Marketplace co-sell routes. Targets healthcare, financial services, manufacturing and cybersecurity verticals.

title: EU EDF — €1.07B Invested in 57 Collaborative Defence R&D Projects
summary: The European Commission selected 57 collaborative R&D projects for €1.07 billion in EU Defence Fund investment, involving 634 entities from 26 EU member states plus Norway. SMEs make up 38%+ of participants. Flagship Project STRATUS develops an AI-powered cyber defence system for drone swarms including a Ukrainian subcontractor — the first time Ukrainian entities participate in EDF projects. Directly shaped by battlefield lessons from Ukraine.

title: Novo Nordisk × OpenAI — AI Across Drug Discovery to Commercial Operations
summary: Novo Nordisk announced a strategic partnership with OpenAI to integrate advanced AI across the entire business — from drug discovery to commercial operations. Covers analysis of complex datasets, identifying drug candidates, manufacturing, supply chain and corporate functions. Pilot programmes launching in 2026, full integration by end of year. Strict data governance and human oversight built in.

title: Meta × CoreWeave — $21B AI Cloud Capacity Deal Through 2032
summary: Meta signed a fresh $21 billion agreement with CoreWeave for dedicated AI cloud capacity through December 2032 — on top of the existing $14.2B deal from September 2025. The multi-site deployment includes early Nvidia Vera Rubin GPU usage and powers Meta's inference workloads for its new Muse Spark AI model.

title: Joybuy × Competera — AI Pricing Automation for JD.com’s New European Marketplace
summary: Joybuy — JD.com's new European online retail platform launched in March 2026 across the UK, Germany, Netherlands, France, Belgium and Luxembourg — partnered with Competera's AI pricing platform to automate competitive pricing intelligence across all EU markets. Teams now receive real-time market insights daily to adjust prices before peak hours, replacing manual spreadsheet-based monitoring as Joybuy scales rapidly across Europe.

title: Prologis × La Caisse — €1.6B Pan-European Logistics Joint Venture (PLIVE)
summary: Prologis and La Caisse (formerly CDPQ) launched PLIVE — a pan-European logistics joint venture with €1.6B in seed assets spanning income-generating properties and development sites. La Caisse holds 70%, Prologis 30% as operating partner. The platform targets Europe's key logistics corridors as reshoring, nearshoring and e-commerce drive structural demand.

title: Tredence × Google Cloud — Enterprise Agentic AI at Scale
summary: Tredence expanded its global strategic partnership with Google Cloud to help enterprises operationalise agentic AI at scale — moving beyond experimentation to last-mile, production-grade AI deployment. The collaboration targets financial services, retail, healthcare and other regulated sectors with 800+ trained AI specialists.

title: IBM × Arm — Dual-Architecture Enterprise Computing for AI Workloads
summary: IBM and Arm announced a strategic collaboration on April 2, 2026 to develop dual-architecture hardware enabling enterprises to run AI and data-intensive workloads with greater flexibility, reliability and security. The deal combines IBM's mission-critical systems expertise — including the Telum II processor and Spyre AI Accelerator — with the Arm software ecosystem, targeting financial services, healthcare and government infrastructure.

title: Bain Capital × AQ Compute — Green AI Data Centre Buildout Across Europe
summary: Bain Capital acquired an 80% majority stake in AQ Compute from Germany's Aquila Group to accelerate the buildout of green, AI-ready data centres across Europe. The partnership targets multi-billion euro development volumes, offering modular colocation capabilities for hyperscale, cloud and AI customers with a sustainability-first approach.

title: LHV Bank × Gradient Labs — Europe’s First Agentic AI Banking Pilot
summary: LHV Bank launched a proof-of-concept with Gradient Labs — founded by ex-Monzo staff — to deploy AI agents for retail customer support. The pilot tests how explainable agentic AI can handle customer enquiries more efficiently and consistently, without sacrificing accountability. One of Europe’s first live agentic AI banking deployments.

title: EU Signs Space Connectivity Agreement with Norway and Iceland for IRIS² and GOVSATCOM
summary: The EU signed a formal agreement on March 26, 2026 allowing Norway and Iceland to join GOVSATCOM and IRIS², the EU's sovereign satellite connectivity programme. The deal gives both Nordic countries access to secure satellite communications for crisis management, government operations, disaster response, climate monitoring, and air and maritime navigation.

title: DHL eCommerce × Correios de Portugal — EU-Approved Joint Venture
summary: The European Commission unconditionally approved the DHL eCommerce and Correios de Portugal joint venture under EU Merger Regulation. The JV combines DHL's international parcel network with Portugal's national postal infrastructure, strengthening last-mile delivery capabilities across the Iberian Peninsula and EU cross-border corridors.

title: Solaris × SBI Group — Europe’s First AI-Native Bank Transformation
summary: German Banking-as-a-Service platform Solaris repositioned as Europe's first AI-native bank, backed by SBI Group. The transformation rebuilds banking processes from the ground up using AI, with ADAC and Boerse Stuttgart as key live partners — framed within the EU AI Act and DORA compliance frameworks.

title: Barclays and Sage Launch Embedded Finance Partnership for UK SMEs
summary: Barclays and Sage have announced a strategic partnership integrating business banking with accounting software for UK small and medium-sized businesses. The collaboration directly addresses Making Tax Digital for Income Tax requirements while helping SMEs reduce the 24 working days per year typically lost to financial administration.

title: Visa Agentic Ready — 21 European Banks Launch AI Agent Payment Programme
companies: Visa, Barclays, HSBC UK, Commerzbank, Revolut, Santander, Nexi, Raiffeisen, DZ Bank, Nationwide
summary: Visa launched its Agentic Ready programme in Europe first, enrolling 21 issuing partners — including Barclays, HSBC UK, Commerzbank, Revolut, Santander, Nexi, Raiffeisen, DZ Bank and Nationwide — to test and validate AI agent-initiated payments in live production environments. Banco Santander already completed Europe's first live AI agent payment using a Visa credential in Spain.

title: JPMorgan Payments and Mastercard Launch B2B Virtual Card in Europe
summary: JPMorgan Payments and Mastercard have launched a new virtual card product across Europe targeting travel, healthcare, and accounts payable workflows. The deal also leverages Mastercard's B2B Supplier Enablement & Activation Service to accelerate onboarding of suppliers onto digital payment programs, replacing legacy cheque-based processes.

title: OpenAI and AWS Sign Deal to Supply AI to US Government
summary: OpenAI signed a partnership with AWS to distribute its AI products to US government agencies for both classified and unclassified workloads via AWS GovCloud and AWS Classified Regions. OpenAI retains control over which models are made available and requires advance notice before enabling especially sensitive intelligence customers.

title: Mastercard Acquires London-Based BVNK for $1.8B to Bridge Stablecoin and Fiat Payments
summary: Mastercard announced the acquisition of BVNK, a London-based stablecoin infrastructure startup, for up to $1.8 billion. BVNK's platform enables sending and receiving payments across all major blockchain networks in 130+ countries, processing over $25 billion annually. The deal positions Mastercard to connect traditional card rails, bank rails, stablecoins, and tokenised deposits into a single unified payment network — directly responding to the European regulatory push for payment sovereignty.

title: OpenAI and Booking.com Launch SME AI Accelerator Across 6 European Countries
summary: OpenAI partnered with Booking.com to launch an SME AI Accelerator programme, aiming to train 20,000 small businesses across France, Germany, Italy, Poland, Ireland, and the UK. The initiative combines in-person workshops with virtual training on OpenAI Academy, targeting business owners with no technical background as part of OpenAI's EU Economic Blueprint 2.0 strategy.

title: Visa and Fiserv Expand European Payments Platform Partnership
summary: Visa and Fiserv expanded their long-standing partnership to roll out the Visa Acceptance Platform across Fiserv's merchant acquiring and processing solutions in Europe. The unified API-driven acceptance layer simplifies integration for acquirers, improves authorisation rates, reduces fraud and chargebacks, and gives merchants richer transaction data across online, in-store and contactless payments.

title: Nvidia Agent Toolkit — 17 Enterprise Platforms Adopt Open AI Agent Infrastructure at GTC 2026
companies: Nvidia, Salesforce, Adobe, SAP, ServiceNow, Siemens, Cisco, CrowdStrike, Atlassian
summary: At GTC 2026 on March 16, Nvidia launched its open-source Agent Toolkit and announced 17 enterprise software platforms — including Salesforce, Adobe, SAP, ServiceNow, Siemens, Cisco, CrowdStrike and Atlassian — building their next-generation AI agents on Nvidia's shared infrastructure. The toolkit includes OpenShell (a secure agent runtime), Nemotron models, and AI-Q blueprints. Salesforce integrates it into Agentforce via Slack, SAP into Joule Studio, and Adobe into its Firefly creative pipelines.

title: Meta Signs $27B GPU Cloud Deal with Nebius for Next-Gen AI Infrastructure
summary: Meta committed up to $27B to Nebius Group for five years of dedicated GPU cloud capacity, co-anchoring the commercial launch of Nvidia's Vera Rubin GPU platform. Nvidia simultaneously announced a $2B investment in Nebius to build multiple gigawatt-scale AI factories in the US. The deal signals a structural shift toward long-term, pre-committed AI compute contracts rather than spot cloud markets.

title: Telefónica Leads EURO-3C: 70+ Orgs Unite for Sovereign European Cloud & AI
summary: Telefónica announced EURO-3C at Mobile World Congress Barcelona — a European Commission-backed initiative joining 70+ telecoms, tech companies, and SMEs to build a federated sovereign cloud, AI, and edge infrastructure across Europe. The project prioritises agentic AI, automotive, e-health, and government cloud use cases, positioning Europe to reduce dependency on US cloud infrastructure.

title: EU and Switzerland Sign Landmark Bilateral Agreements Modernising Single Market Access
summary: The EU and Switzerland signed a comprehensive package of updated bilateral agreements (Bilaterals III) on March 2, 2026, modernising one of Europe's most important partnerships. The deal smooths access to the EU's 460 million consumer market for Swiss businesses, aligns rules across transport, free movement of persons, and mutual recognition, and opens Swiss universities to EU students without additional fees.

title: EPC Wero Expands Retail Payments Partnership to France and Belgium After Germany Launch
companies: European Payments Council, Wero, Lidl, Decathlon
summary: The European Payments Council's Wero platform, already live in Germany with major retailers including Lidl, Decathlon, Rossmann, and Air Europa, is expanding retail payment partnerships into France and Belgium in 2026. With over 1,100 participating financial institutions, Wero is Europe's answer to reducing dependency on Visa and Mastercard for retail payments across the eurozone.

title: Amazon Invests $50B in OpenAI with $100B AWS Cloud Expansion
summary: Amazon and OpenAI announced a landmark multi-year strategic partnership: Amazon investing $50B in OpenAI while expanding their cloud agreement by $100B over 8 years. AWS becomes the exclusive third-party cloud distributor for OpenAI Frontier, OpenAI commits to 2 gigawatts of Trainium chip capacity, and both companies will co-create a Stateful Runtime Environment on Amazon Bedrock for enterprise AI agents.

title: Tieto Signs Multi-Year Cloud Infrastructure Deal with Orange Business
summary: Nordic tech company Tieto has signed a multi-year frame agreement with Orange Business, migrating all four of its business units to Orange Business's sovereign European cloud platform Cloud Avenue. Tieto Banktech will begin cloud migrations in H2 2026, with the remaining units following over a two-year transition period.

title: Accenture and Mistral AI Launch Multi-Year Enterprise AI Collaboration
summary: Accenture and Paris-based Mistral AI announced a multi-year strategic collaboration to scale sovereign, enterprise-grade AI across Europe and globally. The two companies will co-develop industry-specific AI solutions, with Accenture training thousands of its professionals on Mistral AI's models and embedding Mistral's technology into client solutions with a focus on regulatory compliance and data sovereignty.

title: Adyen Powers In-Store Payments Across 940+ Starbucks European Stores
summary: Adyen has rolled out its unified payment infrastructure across 943 Starbucks locations in the UK, Austria, and Switzerland, deploying 2,375 payment terminals. The deal, built on Adyen's Store and Forward technology, ensures uninterrupted payments even during network outages — a critical capability at the scale Starbucks operates.

title: OpenAI and ServiceNow Expand Multi-Year AI Enterprise Partnership
summary: OpenAI and ServiceNow announced an expanded multi-year strategic partnership giving ServiceNow customers access to OpenAI's latest models across IT, HR, and customer service workflows. The deal embeds OpenAI's voice and agentic AI capabilities directly into ServiceNow's platform, enabling speech-to-speech enterprise automation without ServiceNow needing to build frontier models in-house.
